question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: We have 10 people on the team. I was the co-founder of LeadIQ, the leading sales intelligence platform. I managed a fast-growing team of 50 remote employees and onboarded everyone while creating a platform that handled millions of dollars every year. Mert is the CTO and he has over 10 years of experience building device security. Mert and I have both experienced issues of device security and Mert has been building a similar solution for the past 5 years. Jeremy is our sales. He was a former YC founder and recently joined us to drive our sales. He used to host virtual YC demo days.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: Our batch mentor guided us on product iteration and helped us with pitch practices. We genuinely appreciate Tim, Aaron, and Kevin’s mentorship to help us grow!

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: We worked with many YC companies to help with their device management and compliance needs. We also launched our own YC deal to help new YC batch companies can quickly ramp up their remote device management.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: In 2022, we discovered the power of ChatGPT and realized that we can leverage its platform to simplify device management and remote employee management. This was the pivot point of our product.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Swif is revolutionizing device security with AI,  we are the first to eliminate the Shadow IT problem—empowering businesses with complete control, visibility, and security.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?

launches.title: Swif: Solve Shadow IT with our Chrome extension
launches.tagline: Gain full control over Shadow IT—track, secure, and manage unauthorized apps with ease using Swif's Chrome Extension.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84069&key=user_uploads/28055/554bc23e-0c52-44e5-b8e5-d956361fc467)

Hey, YC community! We’re the team at [Swif](https://www.swif.ai?utm_source=yclaunch), and we're excited to introduce our **Swif Chrome Extension**, designed to solve the growing issue of Shadow IT in organizations. As businesses scale, it's easy for employees to start using unauthorized SaaS apps, creating security and compliance risks that IT teams struggle to monitor.

**What’s the problem?** Shadow IT refers to apps and services used by employees without IT’s knowledge or approval. This often leads to unmonitored data access, increasing the risk of breaches, non-compliance, and lost productivity. Even well-managed IT teams find it hard to track all software being used across departments.

**How does Swif’s Chrome Extension fix this?** Our Chrome Extension helps you automatically identify and monitor employee access to unauthorized SaaS apps. With **real-time visibility**, Swif detects email and password sign-ups to unapproved apps, enabling IT teams to track usage, ensure compliance, and take action quickly—before a security risk escalates. The extension fits seamlessly into your existing IT workflow, providing a single dashboard for comprehensive oversight.

Swif’s strength lies in its automation. Instead of manually hunting down unapproved apps, our extension monitors usage, generates compliance reports, and offers automated solutions for securing access. This gives you control without adding complexity, saving both time and resources.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84069&key=user_uploads/28055/13b44543-ebbc-4d61-ad14-5dd5150a1dd1)

**Why did we build it?** The idea came from our experience working with companies overwhelmed by Shadow IT problems. We saw firsthand how much of a challenge it is to maintain visibility over what employees are using, especially in remote and hybrid work environments. Our mission was to create a tool that does the heavy lifting for IT departments, making it easier to manage without sacrificing security or efficiency.

**What’s next?** We’re excited to offer early access to the Swif Chrome Extension! If you’re managing a fleet of devices or overseeing IT security, sign up to be among the first to try our solution and take control of Shadow IT.

**Call to Action**: Ready to tackle Shadow IT? [Create a Swif account](https://app.swif.ai/chromeextension?utm_source=yclaunch), download the extension, and start managing your apps with ease!

launches.title: Swif.ai - Compliance-First Device Security
launches.tagline: The YC's Get Start Package for MDM & Compliance Automation
launches.body:
### **⛔️The problem**

1. Fragmented device management across multiple operating systems and locations.
2. Time-consuming manual compliance checks and reporting for various regulatory standards.
3. Inefficient onboarding and offboarding processes for remote and global teams.
4. Lack of visibility into shadow IT and unauthorized SaaS application usage.

### **🚀The solution**

[Swif.ai](http://Swif.ai) offers a comprehensive solution for device security, compliance management, and IT administration across Linux, Windows, and macOS. It automates patch management for various compliance frameworks, provides real-time compliance status reports, and enables remote device control. Swif's all-in-one platform integrates with HR systems, simplifying employee onboarding and offboarding processes while offering cost-effective access management compared to traditional SSO solutions.

**Customer Benefits**

1. Unified visibility and control over all organizational devices, regardless of operating system or location.
2. Significant time savings through automated compliance readiness checks and real-time reporting.
3. Enhanced security posture with the ability to instantly lock or wipe compromised devices remotely.
4. Reduced IT overhead by consolidating device management, access control, and compliance tools into a single platform.

### **🛠️How it works**

launches.title: Swif - One-stop device management and security
launches.tagline: Order, equip, manage your devices for your distributed teams
launches.body:
Hello, everyone! This is [Angelo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angelokh/) here to introduce [Swif](https://www.swif.ai?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=yc_launch)!

❌ **The Problem**

In my last startup LeadIQ, I managed 2 remote teams in the US and Singapore. It was really painful to manage devices and cloud app access for employees in different locations. We wanted a better understanding of company devices and employee’s cloud app access, and we used a giant Excel sheet to solve this problem, only to find that the solution can not scale. We took time to find solutions to set up, configure, and then discover that the capabilities of each solution were incomplete or buggy. Companies were wasting money and time. The challenges were real, painful and increased company risks. Employee onboarding and offboarding were a nightmare.

✨ **Our Solution**

Swif helps distributed teams manage their devices, purchase new ones, and retrieve them when employees leave the company. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66625&key=user_uploads/28055/4b87f21a-cf0d-4381-b7ba-286c4c293b40)

Why do we need a new solution for device management?

You might work in California but have team members distributed in Texas, New York, Paris, and Singapore. Things like these might occur to you:

1. Sending, retrieving, and storing devices for remote teams is painful. 
2. Losing data for security risks could keep you up at night.
3. Employee data is across multiple platforms, eg. Gusto and Deel, and have no audit trails of who owns which devices.

👉 **Next steps**

1. Sign up for [Swif](https://www.swif.ai?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=yc_launch) and subscribe with promo code ‘ycdeal’ to enjoy one-year free premium features.
2. Import your employees from your HRIS. We currently support 30 HRIS connections!
3. Follow the Quick Start to set up your system to enroll devices and link us to your Apple business manager.

Want to start taking control of your remote fleet? 

Visit us at <https://www.swif.ai> or reach out to us at [support@swif.ai](https://mailto:support@swif.ai).
